jobs.title: Software Engineer, Machine Learning - Ads Products
jobs.description:
Meta's Ads organization builds the systems that help businesses of every size reach the people most likely to care about what they offer. At our core, we're builders who care about shipping real value. We own the advertiser-facing side of that work, end to end: the campaign and optimization products that drive advertiser results; the business experiences where advertisers plan, create, and manage their work, from a first boosted post to a global agency's workflow; the signals, attribution, and measurement that prove what their advertising delivered; and the payments and financial systems the money moves through, along with the integrity work that keeps them trusted. AI is changing all of it - what we build for advertisers and how we build it - and ours is the org where advertiser value is won or lost.As a Software Engineer, Machine Learning in Ads Products, you will lead complex engineering projects that turn ML capabilities into useful advertiser products. You will develop and integrate models for campaign optimization and advertiser experiences, partnering with product, data science, and engineering teams to define success, evaluate improvements, and deliver reliable capabilities that help businesses achieve better advertising results.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Machine Learning - Ads Products Responsibilities:**

* Define and deliver ML-powered product capabilities for campaign optimization or advertiser experiences, from technical design through launch and iteration.
* Translate advertiser and product needs into model objectives, evaluation methods, and maintainable production software.
* Use data and analysis to diagnose model and product behavior, compare technical approaches, and guide engineering decisions.
* Partner with product, data science, and engineering teams to design experiments and assess advertiser outcomes.
* Lead cross-functional execution across model, data, service, and product integration dependencies for complex projects.
* Improve model and product quality through testing, rollout controls, monitoring, and production feedback.
* Mentor engineers in ML product design, evaluation, and reliable delivery.
* Help teammates ramp up across the model, data, service, and product codebases.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 4+ years experience with a PhD
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with privacy-preserving measurement and modeling under signal loss (e.g. aggregated/delayed conversion signals)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Data Curation - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer for our Autonomous Vehicles Data Curation team. The role involves applying state-of-the-art techniques to search, curate, and evaluate high-quality datasets and ground truth for autonomous vehicles, a critical aspect of our next-generation products. You will have the opportunity to work with top researchers and engineers in the field of deep learning and computer vision to deliver impact to our customers around the world. Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving car powered by AI can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. The era of AI has begun. NVIDIA's GPUs run Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and act as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human imagination and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and AI come together in our architecture.

  

NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for Deep Learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI company”. Make your choice to join us today. We are training Deep Neural Networks and developing data search and curation capabilities for NVIDIA's Autonomous Vehicles effort, with the goal to enable autonomous driving. We are seeking Deep Learning/Machine Learning engineers who are passionate about building the datasets and tools that support perception, prediction, planning and control for self-driving cars to achieve full autonomy. Are you interested in applying AI to discover and understand challenging driving scenarios at scale? If so, join us!

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Stay up to date with the latest research and innovations in deep learning, implement and experiment with new ideas.
* Foster collaborative partnerships with our researchers and engineers, transforming innovative research into robust, industrial-strength machine learning models.
* Taking approaches from initial evaluation and experimentation all the way to shipping.
* Defining, collecting, and curating training and evaluation datasets, with a focus on scenario coverage and label quality.
* Developing vision-language models and embeddings for scenario search, classification, and automated data curation.
Building training pipelines and scalable inference systems (PyTorch, TensorFlow, TensorRT, Python, C++).  

  

**What we need to see:**

* PhD with 1+ year, or MS (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years, of relevant experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Proven experience building robust software.
* Passionate about Artificial Intelligence for robotics and autonomous navigation
* Strive to learn new things and like solving hard problems
* Math knowledge
* Experience in Deep Learning / Machine Learning. You have a background in Computer Vision and/or multimodal learning.
* Programming and debugging skills in C++ and/or Python.
Good communication and analytical skills. Ability to work with multiple teams in a dynamic environment.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Background in applying latest AI methods to solve Computer Vision and Autonomous Vehicles problems
* Experience with Unsupervised or Self-supervised Learning and contrastive representation learning.
Experience with vision-language models, agentic search, or automated dataset quality evaluation.  

  

We believe that realizing self-driving cars will be a defining contribution of our generation. We have the funding and scale, but we need your help. NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

  

#AutonomousVehicles

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
  
152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 11, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Research Scientist Intern, Generative AI & 3D Generation (PhD)
jobs.description:
Meta Reality Labs brings together researchers and engineers to invent the future of visual computing. Our teams develop technologies that enable people to capture, create, understand, and interact with immersive visual experiences across Meta’s products and AR/VR platforms. We work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computer vision, computer graphics, and computational photography. Our research spans 3D generation across assets, characters, and worlds, together with rigging and animation. We are working on neural 3D generation (e.g., mesh, gaussian splats, topology, texture) as well as agentic 3D generation and understanding (e.g., 3D code generation, robotic simulation).As a Research Scientist Intern, you will help advance the state of the art through an ambitious research project. You will collaborate with researchers and engineers to develop new models, representations, datasets, and evaluation methods—with opportunities to publish your work and influence future products used by people around the world.  
  
  

### **Research Scientist Intern, Generative AI & 3D Generation (PhD) Responsibilities:**

* Research, develop and prototype advanced technologies in the domain of 3D Generation, Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, using ML methods including diffusion models, LLMs, and Agentic RL.
* Deliver research results that are both publishable and have a direct impact on Reality Labs or Meta’s Family of Apps Analyze the efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and stability of currently deployed technologies to identify opportunities for impact through novel research.
* Collaborate with team members throughout the lifetime of a project, from research to prototyping to deploying products.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Currently is in the process of obtaining a PhD degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related fields
* Experience in one or more areas of Computer Science, such as 3D Generation, Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, Machine Learning, LLMs, and Reinforcement Learning
* Proven track record of achieving significant results as demonstrated by grants, fellowships, patents, as well as co-authored publications at top-tier conferences
* Experience with modern C++ and/or Python
* Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Intent to return to their degree program after the completion of the internship Interpersonal experience: cross-group and cross-culture collaboration
* Strong communication skills and ability to convey research ideas to a broad audience
* Broad understanding of the full machine vision pipeline from sensors to high-level algorithms
* Mathematical background and understanding of linear algebra, numerical optimization, probabilistic estimation, Understanding of 3D geometry

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Video SWE
jobs.description:
Meta's Wearables Media Codec and Framework team develops the video encoding and media capture software that powers wearable experiences. We are looking for a Video Codec Software Engineer to build and optimize codec implementations and hardware-accelerated media pipelines for resource-constrained devices like smart glasses.In this role, you will own technical problems from camera capture through encoding, media containers, and audio/video synchronization. You will balance compression efficiency, visual quality, latency, power consumption, thermal limits, and memory usage, working across media frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers. Partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams, you will help define the architecture and technical direction of wearable media systems.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Video SWE Responsibilities:**

* Architect, implement, and troubleshoot video codec and media capture pipelines for wearable devices, from camera capture through encoding and media output
* Develop, configure, and tune video encoders, including rate control and compression algorithms, to improve encoding efficiency and visual quality
* Optimize codec performance within device power, thermal, latency, and memory constraints, using profiling and measurement to evaluate trade-offs
* Integrate hardware-accelerated video codecs with mobile and embedded media stacks, working across application processor frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers
* Develop and improve media container handling, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization across the capture and encoding pipeline
* Diagnose and resolve video artifacts, synchronization issues, and performance regressions through codec-level and end-to-end system debugging
* Lead technical design and execution for complex media projects, partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams to define interfaces, resolve integration challenges, and guide technical roadmaps
* Build and improve automated tests and regression infrastructure for code correctness, visual quality, performance, and power consumption

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant technical field
* 7+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 4+ years of experience
* 3+ years relevant video software engineering experience in industry settings with understanding of multimedia stack, codecs, containers
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience leading large or complex projects, defined goals and delivered milestones by leading teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with image compression and formats such as JPEG, HEIC/HEIF, or raw/Bayer compression
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience developing automated media regression tests or working with codec tools and libraries such as FFmpeg, libavcodec, x264/x265
* Experience integrating hardware-accelerated video encoding on mobile or low-power systems-on-chip, using media interfaces such as Android MediaCodec, Codec2, OpenMAX, or V4L2
* Knowledge of codec internals, including rate control, motion estimation, intra/inter prediction, rate-distortion optimization, and bitstream analysis
* Experience with media-path firmware or kernel drivers, camera capture integration, or direct collaboration with silicon vendors on hardware-software integration
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience evaluating visual quality using metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, or VMAF, and diagnosing compression artifacts and quality regressions
* Experience with media containers such as MP4/ISOBMFF, muxing and demuxing, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization
* Experience designing and optimizing media software within power, thermal, latency, and memory bandwidth constraints on wearable, mobile, or embedded devices
* Experience implementing, configuring, or tuning production video encoders using standards such as H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1

Our team bridges the gap between complex routing protocols and data plane performance to meet the rigorous demands of modern service providers and hyperscale networks.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (Kubernetes)
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join an early-stage infrastructure team building tools that simplify production Kubernetes operations for demanding AI workloads. You will help develop the platform and systems behind reliable, multi-cluster infrastructure.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build platform features in Go, including custom Kubernetes operators and controllers.
* Design GitOps workflows with ArgoCD to streamline continuous deployment.
* Create infrastructure-as-code patterns with Terraform and Helm to provision and manage clusters.
* Work on distributed storage using Ceph and WEKA.
* Build observability systems with Prometheus and Grafana to surface cluster health and performance.
* Optimize container networking with Cilium and related technologies.
* Design federated Kubernetes architectures for multi-cluster management.
* Automate recurring infrastructure work and reduce operational overhead for production workloads.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of software development experience, with around 5 years preferred.
* Hands-on experience writing Go for Kubernetes environments, including production-scale cluster management.
* Experience with distributed storage such as Ceph or WEKA and federated, multi-cluster Kubernetes architectures.
* Experience with GitOps and ArgoCD, plus infrastructure as code using Terraform, Helm, or comparable tools.
* Familiarity with container networking, CNI plugins, service meshes, and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Experience with cloud Kubernetes offerings, bare-metal infrastructure, or GPU workloads is useful.
* Automation experience and contributions to Kubernetes or other open-source infrastructure projects are valued.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary is $180,000 to $210,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineering Technical Leader
new_jobs.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 11/09/2026
  
  
Meet the Team
  
  
The Routing Engineering team for the Cisco 8000 platform focuses on developing high-performance software solutions for cloud-scale infrastructure within the IOS-XR environment.
  
We specialize in architectural optimization, ensuring robust packet forwarding and reliable system operations across modular hardware platforms. Our team bridges the gap between complex routing protocols and data plane performance to meet the rigorous demands of modern service providers and hyperscale networks.
  
  
Impact
  
  
Develops software consistent with Cisco ‘Design Thinking Principles with a focus on simplification and UX (User Experience) at its core, using secure coding practices, ensuring user privacy, and following software development best practices. Partners with other teams, including design and product management to create the right solution for the customers. Creates technical design documentation to be used by the team as well as contributing to user documentation to be used by end users. Debugs and addresses software issues during development and in production systems to support customers. Brings new ideas for product innovation and helps improve software development processes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  

* Uses specialized expertise to interpret business issues, recommend best practices, and solve complex problems. Mentors others, leads small-to-medium features, and manages projects that span multiple teams.
* Writes clean, functional code that sets team standards. Influences architectural decisions (security, scalability, reliability) and articulates design choices based on market awareness and competitive analysis.
* Advocates for and innovates new features and products to address unmet customer needs. Influences and tracks metrics to measure success.
* Provides expertise in the SDLC and agile strategies. Scopes work accurately, provides reliable project estimates, and negotiates delivery trade-offs with cross-functional partners.
* Contributes to product threat modeling and proactively resolves risks in production. Designs robust monitoring tools to increase performance.
* Leads postmortems and root cause analyses. Facilitates team knowledge sharing (e.g., brownbags, demos) and contributes to the wider professional community through blogs or publications.
* Serves as an expert on multiple functional components.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors + 8 years of related experience, or Masters + 6 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience.
* Experience in all phases of SW development cycle with exposure to agile development methodologies
* Experience with tech stack C/ C++ or Python
* Experience with networking protocols

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Familiarity with Linux and modern software tools and techniques for development/debugging and validated software design and development skills
* Experience with Service provider, data center technologies and architectures
* Knowledge of VMs and virtualization technologies
* Development experience in L2/ L3 Forwarding

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
